rationale: A wins because it keeps three real lanes separate and knows where the bodies are buried: “Liquid Death opens a store that sells almost no water,” the $4.2M giving audit, and the B Corp standards test are different stories with different desks and proof burdens. B has usable bones, but “Profitable at contribution margin, Liquid Death opens a flagship. The financial bet is implied” asks a reporter to build a finance story out of inference and fixed-cost vibes. A is sharper, more honest about decay, and much tougher on what must be proven before anyone pitches.
gaps_in_A: “Liquid Death opens a store that sells almost no water” overstates the given facts; the update says the store sells merch, limited-edition canned water, and events, but gives no floor-share or sales-mix evidence.

“an aluminum single-serve packaged-water brand clearing a certification whose audience associates it with the opposite kind of company” is a plausible tension, but it leans on an unproven assumption about B Corp audience perception.
The donation angle calls $4.2M “sizable” before establishing denominator, recipient confirmation, or timeframe; A wisely asks for those later, but the adjective gets ahead of the evidence.
gaps_in_B: “most beverage brands at 120,000 retail doors add more doors, not their own” is a broad category claim with no support in the update. That is not color; it is homework pretending to be fact.

“B Corp certification belongs to earnest, mission-forward brands in wellness, food, or apparel” invents a prevailing belief instead of proving one. A reporter covering certification standards will not accept your vibes as a source.
“The contribution-margin disclosure is the financial signal; both are current” treats a supplied company fact as a current disclosure tied to the store opening. The update does not say that.

“Next step: `meanest-editor` — pick one angle and draft a pitch” is the wrong handoff. These are angle candidates; the next move is fit-checking reporters and filling proof gaps, not asking a critique skill to draft blind.
